buyer_job.buyer: South African small-business owner preparing a funding application
buyer_job.source_text: Use my business information, financial notes, funding opportunity, founder material and supporting documents to prepare a funding proposal pack, show readiness gaps, develop the evidence-bound proposal narrative, and prepare the professional submission correspondence. Do not invent approval, affordability, legal conclusions, customer acceptance, willingness to pay, or authority to send anything externally.

required_outcomes.meaning: Assess finance-application evidence readiness, assumptions and missing evidence without making a lending decision.
Turn source-bound evidence and readiness findings into a structured professional proposal narrative with traceable claims.
Prepare professional submission correspondence without sending it or creating settlement, approval or other external authority.
